intro: Source-audited non-graphic plot design covering Dhika–Chotu, Sharmi, John, neighbour Uncle, plumber Iroh, nephew Zuko, unnamed workmen, Leo, twins and the anonymous Stranger. guardrails: Original author source ends at EP41; EP42–64 proposals are not published original episodes.
The original source and reconstructed 69-episode analysis follow different numbering systems; legacy citations are separately identified.
Dhika and Chotu have existing physical intimacy history: do not call a renewed kiss their first.
Sharmi–Chotu intimate milestones are new proposals, not verified original canon.
John can be a viewer only in a separately negotiated context. No secret recording, privacy violations or automatic multi-person participation.
Neighbour Uncle is different from plumber Iroh and from Zuko; plumber workman names remain unverified.
The Stranger's identity and the bathtub delivery date remain unresolved until verified or deliberately authored.
Pappu is a child and appears only in nonsexual family logistics, never in adult intimate contexts.
Earlier Dhika–John intercourse exclusivity is preserved until explicitly changed.
Every adult chooses separately. Boundary violations in earlier scenes are not retroactively reclassified as consensual.
